thread.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jumps 432 Points As Intel, Boeing Rally | Investor's Business Daily

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jumps 432 Points As Intel, Boeing Rally | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Big caps led a broad rally in the stock market today as Intel ( INTC ) and Boeing ( BA ) boosted the Dow Jones industrial average and Coca-Cola ( KO ) broke out.
X The major market indexes nearly gave back their gains midday but rallied back to a strong finish. The Dow Jones today rose 1.8%, while the Nasdaq composite and S&P 500 added 1.6% each in the stock market today . Small caps fared well too with the Russell 2000 gaining nearly 2%. Volumes ran higher on the NYSE and the Nasdaq according to preliminary data, a potentially bullish sign.
Intel led blue chips with a 5% surge to retake its 50-day moving average in above-average trade. It's still 5% below its 200-day line as it tries to halt a jagged decline. Boeing lifted 4% to recoup more than half of its plunge Monday. McDonald's ( MCD ), Nike ( NKE ) and Verizon ( VZ ) added more than 2% each.
Coca-Cola, up 2%, staged a breakout past a 46.97 buy point after its Q3 results topped views. It remains in buy range from the entry, though keep in mind that all purchases are highly risky when the market is in correction. Another caveat: Turnover was about 27% higher than usual, below the 40% minimum threshold that often occurs during the strongest breakouts.
Despite much fanfare ahead of its product launch announcement, Apple ( AAPL ) climbed just 0.5%. The stock has held up better than most tech stocks or the broader market. At 8% off its high, it is still in consolidation mode. Its new products included a refreshed MacBook Air that features a Retina display, a new Mac Mini, and a new iPad Pro and Apple Pencil.
Stock Market Today: IBM Falls Again IBM ( IBM ), down 4%, was left out of the broad blue-chip rally. Shares skidded 4% Monday, amid Big Blue's announcement that it will buy Red Hat ( RHT ) for $34 billion in cash. That would be IBM's biggest acquisition ever.
Software, apparel makers and building-related stocks led the upside among sector gainers. Generic-drug makers, specialty retailers, and oil and gas stocks underperformed.

Canadian outerwear maker Canada Goose joined the IBD 50 on Friday.
Among IBD 50 stocks leading the downside: Texas Roadhouse ( TXRH ), Encompass Health ( EHC ) and Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ), with respective losses of 7%, 6% and 4%. The Innovator IBD 50 ETF ( FFTY ) climbed 1%.
